Class RayTracerBase

java.lang.Object
renderer.RayTracerBase
Direct Known Subclasses:
SimpleRayTracer
abstract class RayTracerBase extends Object
Abstract base class for all ray-tracing strategies.

Holds the scene and provides two protected helper methods that populate the per-intersection and per-light-source cache fields of an Intersectable.Intersection object, so that concrete tracers can read those values without recomputing them.

    • preprocessIntersection

      protected boolean preprocessIntersection(Intersectable.Intersection intersection, Vector rayDirection)
      Pre-computes and caches the per-intersection data needed for shading:
      • intersection.n – surface normal at the hit point
      • intersection.v – the ray's direction vector
      • intersection.vn – dot product n · v
      Parameters:
      intersection - the intersection to populate
      rayDirection - the direction of the camera ray
      Returns:
      true if shading should proceed (i.e. the ray is not grazing the surface); false if n · v == 0

    • preprocessLightSource

      protected boolean preprocessLightSource(Intersectable.Intersection intersection, LightSource lightSource)
      Pre-computes and caches the per-light-source data needed for shading:
      • intersection.l – direction from the light to the hit point
      • intersection.nl – dot product n · l
      • intersection.iL – light intensity at the hit point

      Call this only after preprocessIntersection(Intersectable.Intersection, Vector) has been called (so that intersection.n and intersection.vn are set).

      Parameters:
      intersection - the intersection to populate
      lightSource - the current light source
      Returns:
      true if the light contributes to this point (i.e. the light and the camera are on the same side of the surface); false otherwise
